summary: The 'allowlisted' label filter is a charset check only, so credential-shaped or credentialed-URL values in model.default/provider are echoed verbatim.
failure_scenario: A profile with model.default='sk-<32 hex>' or provider='https://user:pw@10.0.0.5:8080/v1' passes _SAFE_LABEL ([A-Za-z0-9_.:/@+-]{1,128}) and is printed in native_model/native_provider, violating AGENTS.md 'never print private configuration' and the stated metadata-only purpose.
evidence: Ran scripts/profile_summary.py on a synthetic config containing those two values; output JSON contained both strings unchanged (config_read true). Fix would be to emit only booleans/equality or a closed vocabulary, not the raw label, and reject contains_private_material shapes.

summary: _is_public_ip_address treats NAT64 (64:ff9b::/96) addresses as global, so the page-extraction resolver can be steered at internal IPv4 hosts through a DNS64/NAT64 gateway.
failure_scenario: On a DNS64 network, a hostname whose A record is 10.x resolves to 64:ff9b::a00:x; ipaddress.is_global is True, _PublicResolver accepts it, and PublicPageTextExtractor connects to the NAT64 gateway reaching the private host (SSRF guard bypass). Requires a NAT64 environment.
evidence: ipaddress on Python 3.13: 64:ff9b::7f00:1 and 64:ff9b::a00:1 report is_global=True; ::ffff:* and 2002:7f00:1:: are rejected. Runtime exploit not reproduced (needs DNS64); project pins Python 3.11 whose IPv4-mapped handling was not tested.

summary: search_egress.py: binding-scoped authority, strict exact-field/duplicate-key JSON parsing, sequence idempotence/replay rejection, bool-as-int rejection, and admission release paths read as sound; revocation not recalling admitted lookups is documented in the disclosure.
ConsentBoundCurrentFactLookup: admit() precedes delegate lookup and admission.close() is in finally, so no admission leaks on delegate error/cancel.

speech/delivery.py DeliveredSpeechLedger: receipts resolved by object identity with strong refs (no id reuse), cancel_pending releases receipt maps, admissions single-bind, closed-turn eviction bounded; no cross-turn text leakage found.

speech/segmentation.py and speech/types.py: provider timing split preserves exact PCM/text (verified by equality joins), bisect fallback is fail-closed; WordTiming.word is not bound to text[text_start:text_end] but only text ranges are consumed downstream (host_launcher) so no observable defect found.
speech/word_boundary.py: gap search starts at ceil(position/frame) so returned stop is never before position; stop capped at position+0.3s; validation exact.

scripts/candidate_wheel.py: wheel member set, runtime blob sha/size, RECORD, metadata vs static pyproject, entry points and license are bound by equality to the verified source archive; hardcoded 0.0.3 dist-info name fails closed on version bump.

providers/ollama_session.py: prepare/stream mutual exclusion has no await between check and task creation; failed commit after old adapter close marks host closed; cleanup retry path reuses shielded close task. Catalog is cached for the session (stale-digest risk) but not proved as a defect.
Evidence gap: kokoro_worker.py, moonshine.py, ollama.py, ollama_models.py, qualify_spool_crash_matrix.py, benchmark_foreground_knowledge.py and most test files were not reviewed within the timebox.
